title: Jack Got Me Good (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word cabaret 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan warm baritone male vocal absurdist true story Australian family comedy
lyrics:
[Intro - piano bar, dry and expectant]
The Vines Resort.
Christmas time.
Jack and a golf buggy.
The gate.
The woodpile.
Joel.

[Verse 1]
My boy Joel
Was coming through the gate
Home from the Vines
Like a man who had earned it
Jack was behind the wheel
Of the golf buggy
And Jack's foot
Found the wrong pedal
At the wrong moment
In the wrong direction
With my boy Joel
In the gap

[Verse 2]
The woodpile
Did not move
Joel did
Into hospital
Suspected broken leg
Ankle
And he was high as a kite
Which was the medication
The nurses confirmed
Nothing to do with Jack
Or the buggy
Or the woodpile
Joel just took it all
In one evening
Like he does

[Chorus]
Jack got me good
Joel texted his brother
Jack got me good
Three laughing emojis
Jack got me good
Broken leg
Ankle
Woodpile
Golf buggy
Gate
Jack got me good
And I am
Very happy about it
Apparently

[Bridge - spoken, completely level, Chas voice]
He texted me.
"Broken leg. Jack run me over in my golf cart."
Three emojis.
All laughing.
I read it twice.
Then I read it again.
My boy Joel.
In hospital.
Three laughing faces.
That's my boy.

[Verse 3]
The x-rays came later
Full set
The bones told their story
The ankle, the leg
The December situation
Complete
And his brother said
It looked like his own scans
The McIvor family
Apparently shares specific bones
And a specific sense of humour
About the whole thing

[Chorus reprise]
Jack got me good
Three laughing emojis
Jack got me good
Joel from hospital
Jack got me good
Still kicking
Still laughing
Jack got me good
That's my boy

[Outro - piano alone, warm and dry]
Jack
We hope you are well
The woodpile is fine
The gate is still there
The buggy is presumably also still there
And Joel
Is still kicking
He said so himself
With three laughing faces
That's my boy
